scripts.test: bash -lc 'RUST_TEST_THREADS="${RUST_TEST_THREADS:-${TEST_MAX_WORKERS:-2}}" cargo test --jobs "${CARGO_BUILD_JOBS:-${TEST_MAX_WORKERS:-2}}" --workspace --lib --tests' && bun run text-wasm:test && bun run text-analysis-wasm:test && bun run text-linguistics-wasm:test && bun run audio-wasm:test && bun run video-wasm:test && bun run ui:test:unit && bun run web:test:unit && bun run web:test:api
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && bun run ui:typecheck && bun run web:typecheck
scripts.build: cargo build --workspace && bun run ui:build && bun run web:build
scripts.text-native:bench: bash -lc 'cargo bench -p moritzbrantner-text-core -p moritzbrantner-text-linguistics -p moritzbrantner-text-embeddings -p moritzbrantner-text-lexical -p moritzbrantner-text-retrieval -p moritzbrantner-text-analysis'
scripts.text:bench: bun run text-native:bench && bun run text-wasm:bench:all
scripts.web:build: bun run web:build:deps && bun run --cwd prototypes/web/video-analysis-web build
scripts.web:build:deps: bun run dense-wasm:build && bun run text-wasm:build
scripts.web:build:pages: bun run web:build:deps && bun run --cwd prototypes/web/video-analysis-web build:pages
